name: tickadoo-experiences
description: Discover theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences worldwide. Search, compare, check availability, and plan itineraries with tickadoo. No API key required.

interface.longDescription: Discover, compare, and plan theatre, tours, attractions, and live experiences with the public tickadoo catalogue. Calls the discovery-only endpoint at https://mcp.tickadoo.com/mcp/agents with no authentication. It does not return direct checkout or transaction links, create orders, reserve inventory, or collect payment.
defaultPrompt: Find memorable experiences in London this weekend.
Plan a family day out in Paris.
Compare two tickadoo experiences before I choose.
